description: Build complete movie booking system backend with Node.js built-in http module (zero external dependencies) and all API endpoints for movies, showtimes, bookings, food orders, and user accounts. Include file-based JSON storage with seed data.
steps: Create movie-booking/ directory structure: server.js, data/, public/
Implement server.js using Node.js built-in http module with: static file serving for public/ directory, JSON body parsing, URL routing, CORS headers
Implement API routes: GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /api/movies, GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /api/showtimes, GET/POST/DELETE /api/bookings, GET/POST /api/food-orders, GET/PUT /api/users/:id, GET /api/stats
Create data/movies.json with seed data including Bollywood movies like Jawan plus Hollywood like The Nun II with poster placeholder URLs using SVG data URIs
Create data/showtimes.json with sample showtimes for the next 7 days
Create data/bookings.json initialized as empty array
Create data/food-items.json with items: Jumbo Popcorn $9.00, Coca Cola $5.00, French Fries $4.00, and more
Create data/users.json with a sample user Andrew Ainsely
Create package.json with no dependencies, just metadata and start script
Create README.md with setup and usage instructions
Implement UUID generation using Node.js crypto module instead of uuid package
Add proper error handling and input validation on all endpoints
acceptance_criteria: Server starts with `unset NODE_OPTIONS && node movie-booking/server.js` without errors
GET /api/movies returns array of movie objects with all required fields (id, title, genre, duration, rating, language, poster, status)
POST /api/bookings creates a booking and marks seats as booked
No external npm packages are required - only Node.js built-in modules used
All data persists to JSON files in data/ directory
verification: Run `unset NODE_OPTIONS && cd /projects/sandbox/Cluade/movie-booking && node server.js &` then test endpoints with curl
curl http://localhost:3000/api/movies should return JSON array
curl http://localhost:3000/api/showtimes should return JSON array
curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/bookings with valid payload should return 201
